node.title: Re^3: how to escape round parentheses in a system call
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It may work, but I disagree that it is a good solution: it will blow up when $_->{Sub_URL} contains shell metacharacters, and is a security hole if that variable contains any user input.

See [id://1180578]. In this case I would recommend systemx from [mod://IPC::System::Simple], or at the very least the multi-argument [doc://system] (as shown in other replies) with error checking (nobody showed this, but for an example see the first link).

sigh
